title: Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression
scope: Standing main museum and the two stepped southern terraces, after the 2025 reopening at Wanping, Beijing.
limitations: The southern entry and adjacent wings are based on the published CC0 photograph. Roof levels behind the façade, wall heights, window divisions, steps and materials are approximated.
Only the main standing museum and its stair approach are modeled. Interior halls, underground additions, flags, signs, landscaping, reliefs and separate monuments are outside scope.
